solution:

__Detailed Explanation:__

 
• The line XY is the mirror.
 
• The word "123abc" ends with the Letter "c". So, the mirror image will start with "c" ⇒ Option 1 and 3 are eliminated.
 
• The word "123abc" has the last second letter "b". So, the mirror image should be " ⇒ Option 4 is eliminated.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

Hence, **"****O****ption 2"** is the **correct answer.**
